description: Composite industry terminal dashboard payload. (Source: FFIEC + FDIC + FRED.) Dollar amounts are in whole US dollars (not thousands); ratios are percentages.

cert.description: RSSD id of a bank for that bank's full terminal view, or empty / 'all' for the industry aggregate. UBPR peer ranks require Pro; ML risk fields require a free-or-above account (null otherwise).

peer.description: Render as a peer-group aggregate instead of one bank: 'tier:<1-6>' (asset tier) or 'state:<XX>'. Takes precedence over `cert`.

name: industry_dashboard
title: Industry Dashboard
